killedBy: enemy role cues read the tank, not its kind (issues #357, #773) draws no mine block for a tank whose session took its mines away
enemy role cues read the tank, not its kind (issues #357, #773) sizes the block by the tank's own budget, so a raised cap reads wider
why: The cue would state the ROSTER's mine budget rather than this tank's, inside the MINE_LAYER gate. Under `?dev=1&pp1Roles=1` (issue #358) Teal holds MINE_LAYER but carries `mineCap: 0` while its roster entry reads 2, so the cue would draw a mine block on a tank that cannot lay a mine -- contradicting the one thing it reports, on the very arm it would most often be run beside -- and a raised cap on a mine layer would draw the roster's width. Brown and Green, capped at 0 by the same arm, stay bare through the gate either way (issue #1059).
